standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies R^i f_* F with the pushforward of the restriction to the scheme cover.

standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the isomorphism of the comparison map in the scheme case.

core_obligations: Reduce to verifying condition (4) of lemma-general-pushforward: conditions (1)-(3) hold by the cited pullback-lqc, lqc-colimits, check-lqc-on-etale-covering and check-flat-comparison-on-etale-covering (proof lines 1018-1032).

Affine case: for f: X -> Y representable by affine schemes and psi: y -> y' over a flat b: V -> V', form the cartesian diagram with Z, Z' representable by schemes and Z = V x_{V'} Z' (proof lines 1035-1053).

Flat base change: the comparison a^*(F|_{Z'}) -> F|_Z is an iso since F has the fbc property; R^i f_* F restricted to V' (resp. V) equals R^i(f')_{small,*}(F|_{Z'}) (resp. R^i(f'')_{small,*}(F|_Z)) by the cited comparison lemma (proof lines 1053-1072).

Conclude: the comparison map c_psi is an isomorphism by the flat-base-change cohomology lemma of Cohomology of Spaces, and R^i f_* F is locally quasi-coherent by the cited pushforward lemma (proof lines 1073-1087).
proof_roadmap: Cite conditions (1)-(3) of the general pushforward criterion.
Verify condition (4) in the affine case via the cartesian diagram and the flat base change comparison.
difficulty_reason: Framework-application proof: conditions (1)-(3) of the general pushforward criterion are cited, and condition (4) is verified by descending to the affine case with a cartesian diagram of stacks representable by schemes, three restriction equalities for R^i f_*, and the flat base change cohomology comparison of Cohomology of Spaces.
